sights.n: JUNGLIA Okinawa theme park, Nakijin/Nago (ジャングリア沖縄)
sights.w: A 60-hectare nature theme park on a former golf course straddling Nakijin and Nago at the edge of Yanbaru, opened 25 July 2025 by Katana Inc. (led by ex-USJ marketer Tsuyoshi Morioka): animatronic-dinosaur rides, buggy safaris, bungee and an aerial course, plus a spa annex and 15 restaurants (Stars and Stripes; The Japan Times; nippon.com/Jiji).
sights.k: Northern Okinawa's new jungle theme park (opened July 2025)

sights.w: A 10 m-plus waterfall in the Yanbaru forest up the Hennan River beneath Hennan Bridge, reached by a roughly 40-minute river trek with no built path; in summer people swim in its plunge pool. Listed by the OCVB, Tabirai and the official three-village Yanbaru tourism portal (parking 8:00–17:30, last entry 16:30).
sights.k: Wade up a Yanbaru river to a jungle waterfall
